note: Lean states the limit against the boundary distribution W and adds that the integrand is integrable for every ordered height, where M gives nonintegrable integrands the value zero. The identification of W with the vacuum expectation of field words is a separate clause (meets), and labels are S.Union rather than the images iota(A_i).

structure Opens (F : Surface S) : Prop where
  int (n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → S.Union) (y : Heights n) (h : y ∈ east n) (f : Joint n) :
    Integrable (fun x => P.restricted v y x * f x)
  profile (n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → S.Union) (y : Heights n) (hy : y ∈ east n) (f : Joint n) :
    Tendsto (fun ε => atSlopes P v y ε f) (𝓝[>] (0:ℝ)) (𝓝 (F.W n v f))
